pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 45
   C. 36
   D. 30

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

10. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 32
   C. 8
   D. 9

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 1, 6

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
